verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show it auto-fixes flagged bugs, iterates on CI failures, and responds to static-analysis findings (SonarQube and similar), which covers lint-style fixes. Its general migration and refactor work is related but does not directly cover the other three tasks. Explicit test writing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency updating are never documented. Missing for 10: documented test generation, merge-conflict resolution, dependency update workflows, explicit lint-fix docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
